Bellmawr Municipal Court is a city courthouse in Camden County, New York. It has jurisdiction over traffic and vehicle matters, criminal charges, drug cases, offenses by disorderly persons, civil cases, and city ordinance violations. It also handles traffic tickets and summons cases from the Bellmawr Police Department and the New Jersey State Police. This court is an independent government branch that provides fair justice and protects rights and liberties guaranteed by the Constitution and laws of the United States and this State.

How to search for the case record?

Bellmawr Municipal Court records are available online and in the county clerk's offices. They can be found online by using the following ways:

  • Searching by name
  • Searching by case number
  • Searching by address
  • Searching by phone
  • Searching by email

Some recorded information about cases is not available online because they are lawfully confidential. These types of information are only available at the county court office. They can be obtained by giving an Open Public Records Request. Fill in all the information on the form, tell why you want this information, and pay the fees. The court will respond with whether to give this information or not. For more information about the public records, call or mail the court.

see also LaSalle Parish Clerk Of Court

How to file a complaint?

Bellmawr Municipal Court files complaints for any violation that can be made by sending the complaint form to the court. The papers are available on the website and in the clerk's office. Fill in the defendant's name, your name, address, the date of the incident, and the relation with the person you are charging, describe the whole incident in detail, and send it to the court.

The traffic court handles which types of cases?

Bellmawr Municipal Traffic Court handles cases of traffic and vehicle violations. The violation includes speeding, accidents, using cell phones while driving, failing to follow a traffic signal or traffic control device, driving with a suspended or no license, leaving the scene of the accident, and driving recklessly. It also handles the traffic tickets and summons given on the busy roads of route 130, route 168, Interstate Route 295, and the interchange route 76 or highway by the police. Your driving license and driving privileges will be suspended if you do not pay the fine on time. You cannot request your license renewal until the court approves. You need to hire a professional traffic ticket defense attorney if you receive a traffic ticket.

How to send a plea in cases?

Bellmawr Municipal Court can be sent through the mail. A form is available on the website. Two types of plea can be written and sent to court. The types are:

Plea of Guilty

If you are guilty or want to request a defensive driving or deferred disposition, you must tick the plea of a guilty section of traffic or non-traffic cases and then write a note on your act or guilt. Write all the facts in your defense. The judge will consider the points you explain and give you a fine that you must pay on time. After taking the course, your cases can be removed from the records.

Plea of Not Guilty

If you do not feel guilty, tick the plea of a not guilty section of traffic or non-traffic cases, write a note on your defense with some proof and send it to the court. The judge will see all the facts, evidence, and gear from your witness and will give you a schedule; you must appear in court on the date. You cannot request a defensive driving or deferred disposition in this case.

At the end of the form, write the date and your signature and mail it or go to the court in person.

How to make payments?

Bellmawr Municipal Court payments for fines can be made in the following ways:

In-Person

A person can pay for tickets and fines by visiting the court during regular court hours and paying in cash, checks, or with a card at the counter. Convenience and other charges will be applied if you make payment with a credit card. Payment plans are also available by this court.

Online

A person can pay online using the New Jersey online payment link: http://www.njmcdirect.com/. Enter the ticket or citation number and pay the fine. Service fees will be applied in this method.

Mail

A Person can send a certified check or money order to the court's mailing address. The address is 21 E Browning Rd, Bellmawr, NJ 08031, United States. Cash or personal checks are not acceptable in the mail; only certified checks or money orders are accepted.

see also Aiken County Clerk Of Court

How can a person appeal the decision of the court?

You can file an appeal within 20 days of your conviction if you disagree with the judge's decision. $100 is the filing fee for the appeal. A person had to pay a deposit fee that is used for preparing a transcript of the trial. How to appeal a decision of municipal court appeal packet is available, and you can request it from the staff of the court. For other information, visit http://www.njmcdirect.com/.

What are the duties of the clerk?

Bellmawr Municipal Court clerk's role is maintaining each case file, helping judges in case matters, and receiving and handling payment and fines. He is the custodian of the municipal seal. They are responsible for the maintenance of all Official Town Records and the issuance of various licenses. They are an agent of licensing and custodians of the town records. They provide marriage licenses, birth and death certificates, permits, etc.

see also THE COLBERT COUNTY COURTHOUSE

FAQ:

How can I contact the clerk's office?

Visit the clerk's office during business hours or call them.

Phone: 856-931-1087

What happens if I do not come to court on my schedule?

If you do not come to the court on schedule, fines are imposed on you, your insurance or driver's license will be suspended, and in some cases, you will be arrested and sent to jail.

How much would I have to pay if I requested a record?

You had to pay $0.05 per page if you requested to print a letter-size page for the record information or $0.07 per page if you asked to print a legal-size page.
